ignoreValues.reason: FilterBar's sliding active-filter thumb is a single small position:absolute decorative element (not in normal document flow), so animating its width/left cannot cascade into a page-wide reflow -- the practical cost is negligible. A transform-only (scaleX) rewrite was tried and rejected: scaling a rounded-full pill horizontally distorts its end-caps into ellipses instead of semicircles, a worse visual defect than the theoretical layout cost here.
